plugins.name: ahoo-cocache-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for downstream Java/Kotlin applications built on CoCache, the two-level coherent cache (local Caffeine in front of shared Redis): declaring, testing, reviewing and debugging caches, invalidation after commit, Spring Cache, JoinCache, and choosing between Cache, VersionedCache, Store, VersionedStore and SetStore; and implementing CoherenceBackend extensions that pass the cocache-test TCK.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me build, test, review or debug this application's CoCache caches, or implement a CoherenceBackend, using verifiable evidence.
